content.title: MSC Industrial: Fiscal Q1 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: MELVILLE, N.Y. (AP) — MSC Industrial Direct Co. (MSM) on Wednesday reported fiscal first-quarter net income of $51.8 million. On a per-share basis, the Melville, New York-based company said it had profit of 93 cents. Earnings, adjusted for restructuring costs and non-recurring costs, were 99 cents per share.
